name: City of West Sacramento Recreation Leader (extra help)
org: City of West Sacramento Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You plan and lead activities like sports, arts and crafts, science, nature and drama at parks, schools and rec centers. Summer Sports Camp leaders teach kids ages 5 to 12 basic sports skills and teamwork.
who_can_apply: At least 17 at the time of employment, with one year of experience working with youth or the public. Some assignments need CPR and First Aid certificates before you start. You must pass a fingerprint check and drug screen before you start.
pay_detail: $17.00 to $18.50 per hour (2026 postings). Part-time extra help.
deadline_text: No Recreation Leader job is posted as of Oct 16, 2026. Last cycle: Recreation Leader, Customer Service ran Feb 5 to Feb 26, 2026 and again Apr 23 to May 22, 2026. Recreation Leader, Sports Camp Instructor ran Mar 3 to Jun 23, 2026. Expect new postings around February to April 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the whole city job form online on NEOGOV. Add a resume and answer the extra questions. The city reads every form. The top people are sent to the department.
notes: The city also has a Recreation Aide job for ages 15 and up. It paid $17.00 an hour in the 2022 job sheet. But the last Recreation Aide post on the city jobs page ran Aug 29 to Sep 19, 2018. Lead, senior and KidZone leader jobs need a high school diploma or age 18. A 17 year old still needs a California work permit for paid work.
